summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. All 37 pytest tests pass (26 regression + 11 new). Verified: GET /api/stories (4 banners with title_ru/title_ro/color/icon), POST /api/uploads (auth-gated, type-validated, persisted to db.files), GET /api/files/{path} (returns correct content-type and 404 for missing), POST /api/tasks accepts lat/lng/photos and persists them, GET /api/tasks returns distance_km (Haversine) and sorts by distance when geo provided (explicit sort=distance also works), GET /api/tasks/{id}?lat&lng returns distance_km/photos/lat/lng, PATCH /api/auth/profile updates lat/lng. Regression on register/login/me/categories/tasks/applications/accept/chats/messages/specialists all green.

minor.issue: Unused local 'base = os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL', '')' in upload_photo — dead code; should be removed or used to build absolute url.
Endpoint is public (no auth). Any guessable storage_path is downloadable. Consider auth + ownership/ACL check for private uploads.
File type detection relies solely on extension, not magic-bytes. A .png-named text file would be accepted (size check still applies). Add MIME/content sniff for hardening.
Default 'distance-aware sort when location provided' silently overrides recency. Documenting this behavior or requiring explicit sort param would be clearer.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines — still manageable but approaching split threshold (Auth / Tasks / Uploads / Chats routers).
Object storage key cached in module global with single-retry on 403 — fine for MVP but not concurrency-safe under multi-worker uvicorn.
Haversine returns float without bounds checking on lat/lng; out-of-range coords would still compute. Pydantic validation on TaskCreate.lat/lng (range -90..90 / -180..180) would harden input.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Use explicit origins for production.
test_credentials: Dynamic phones generated per-run via _phone() helper (timestamp + uuid suffix) to avoid collision with existing +79991230001/+79991230002.
